scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@shelfwise/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace=@shelfwise/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@shelfwise/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@shelfwise/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@shelfwise/api && npm run build --workspace=@shelfwise/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@shelfwise/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@shelfwise/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@shelfwise/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@shelfwise/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start --workspace=@shelfwise/api" "npm run start --workspace=@shelfwise/web"
